X-18 Endpoints without authorization

Bangla name: অথরাইজেশন ছাড়া endpoint

← 60 · Cross-cutting · Contents · Open queries

1. Name and purpose

Endpoints without authorization. BaseController has its [Authorize] commented out, so a controller action is anonymous unless the controller or the action has an [Authorize] attribute. 137 of the 354 endpoints in the backend have none, or have [AllowAnonymous]. Some are public on purpose (event lists for visitors, payment callbacks), some are internal calls between services and workers (which cannot carry a user token, X-19), and some are admin-portal operations that look like they were meant to be protected. This file lists all of them by category so you can decide what to fix.

Whether API Gateway, the NLB or the ingress blocks any of these from the internet is not visible in the repos (architecture Q1b) [UNCONFIRMED: Q-04].

2. Trigger and actor

Any HTTP client that can reach the service.

3. Business flow

Not a user feature. The categories below say who is meant to call each endpoint.

Endpoint Notes

GET /booking/api/v1/user-booking-order/payment-status-bypass Takes an order's public id in rawData, does not ask the gateway (the status check is commented out and the status is hard-coded Paid, payment info text "BY PASS TRANSACTION - TEST"), marks the order paid, publishes OrderSuccess and asks Ticketing to create tickets; see P-06 and S-01. 9. Handover notes

  1. Decide per category. A: keep anonymous. B: keep anonymous but validate the gateway's signature/data server-side (the DgePay callback re-checks the transaction, P-06); remove payment-status-bypass from production. C: protect with a service identity or network policy; today the only protection is that the paths are not meant to be published (architecture §2.3 B). D: add [Authorize] with the roles the portal menu implies. E: remove.
  2. Adding [Authorize] to C endpoints breaks workers: workers send no token. Introduce a service credential first (the unused service scheme is a starting point, X-14).
  3. Re-run the endpoint extractor used for Appendix B after every change to keep this list true.
